description: Whether a bus needs a commercial driver's license under US federal rules, which class (B or C), and which endorsements (passenger, school bus), from the passenger count, weight rating and whether it carries students. Returns a link to buses for sale in that size. Federal only; states can add rules.

carries_students.description: true if it will carry students to or from school or school events.

passengers.description: Passenger seats, not counting the driver. Count each wheelchair position.

weight.description: Gross vehicle weight rating, from the door-frame label. Default unknown.

name: check_cdl_requirement
